title: P-03 Pôle Administration et Gestion (EN) — Amal Chabab Takaddoum

settings.editor: This area focuses on organizing and coordinating the association's operations.

It contributes to administrative follow-up and the management of the resources needed to support the association's work.

Its fields of work fall within the association's statutory objectives.

settings._title: S1 · IMAGE À REMPLACER — visuel institutionnel

settings.title: An Area of Work Supporting the Association's Organization

settings.editor:
The Administration and Management area is one of the three areas of work established in the bylaws of Association Amal Chabab Takaddoum. It contributes to organizing the association and supporting the operation of its organizational structure.

Its role is to support the activities carried out by the association: it contributes to organizing the association's operations, to administrative follow-up, and to the availability of the resources needed to carry out activities.

In accordance with the bylaws, the organization of the working areas and the monitoring of program implementation fall under the oversight of the Executive Board, elected by the General Assembly.
The area's activities are organized around three complementary fields.

settings._title: S3 · Domaine 1 — Organisation de la vie associative

settings.editor: The area contributes to organizing and coordinating the association's operations. It helps connect the governing bodies, committees, and working areas provided for in the bylaws, and contributes to the continuity of the association's work.

The area contributes to the association's administrative follow-up. This field covers keeping and preserving the association's records, as well as monitoring the administrative obligations associated with its operations.

settings._title: S3 · Domaine 3 — Gestion des moyens nécessaires

settings.editor: The area contributes to managing the resources needed for the association's operations: premises, equipment, and other resources used to carry out its activities. This management is understood as material and organizational support, distinct from accounting and financial functions, which fall under a separate framework.

settings.title: A Cross-Cutting Contribution to the Other Areas

settings.editor:
The area's contribution is not limited to its own scope: it also supports the conditions under which the other two statutory areas carry out their activities.

By supporting organization, administrative follow-up, and the availability of resources, the area contributes to a shared operating framework for the Training and Integration area and the Cultural and Social Activities area.

This support role is carried out within the framework defined by the bylaws, with the Executive Board overseeing the organization of committees and working areas, as well as monitoring the implementation of established programs.

settings.title: The Principles That Guide Its Work

settings.editor: The area's work is guided by the principles that shape the association's commitment.
Making a serious and constructive approach central to commitment.
Recognizing talents, ideas, and the ability to take action.

Overall direction falls to the General Assembly and its oversight to the Executive Board, while committees contribute to reviewing programs and following up on activities within their respective fields.

settings.title: The Other Two Areas of Work

settings.editor: The association's organization is based on three complementary areas established in its bylaws.

settings._title: S6 · Carte 1 — Pôle Formation et Intégration → P-04

settings.editor: This area reflects the association's objectives relating to learning, skills development, and integration.

settings._title: S6 · Carte 2 — Pôle Animation Culturelle et Sociale → P-05

settings.editor: This area supports the objectives relating to culture, community activities, and social participation.
